mission: Veranthos from orbit — almost inviting. Blue-green oceans, temperate forests. But scan data is wrong: weather patterns don't follow rotation, vegetation density doesn't correlate with sunlight, ocean currents reverse without tidal explanation.
why_now: PP25 payoff — the destination promised since Chapter 3. The world the wound lives on.
conflict: The wrongness from orbit is overwhelming — Ben's Force perception flattened by proximity to the wound source. Professional assessment battles visceral dread.
turning_point: The seal boundary from orbit — visible in the Force as a membrane, a pressure change. Inside it, the world is wrong. Outside it, almost normal. The boundary is failing. Patches of wrongness bleed through.
opening_hook: Ben presses his hand against the viewport as Veranthos fills the frame — blue-green oceans, temperate forests, beautiful. The beauty is the first warning.
closing_hook: Desh: 'Her ship is on the surface. Valley coordinates. She's already there.'
emotional_trajectory: Awed dread -> the wrongness made planetary -> urgent tactical alarm

stakes.personal: Ben facing the source of everything he's been feeling since Chapter 1
stakes.interpersonal: The group's reactions to Veranthos reveal their final emotional states before the endgame
stakes.external: Veraine is already at the wound

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — orbit over Veranthos
sensory_details: Veranthos from space: lush, blue-green, inviting; scan data: wrong patterns, impossible biology, reversed currents; the Force: the seal membrane visible as a shimmer in perception; beyond it, the wound — immense, pulling, silent
action_beats: Ben presses his hand against the viewport as Veranthos fills the frame — beautiful, blue-green, wrong
Desh reads scan data aloud: weather patterns contradicting rotation, vegetation defying sunlight, ocean currents reversing
Desh zooms the sensor display to valley coordinates and confirms Veraine's ship is already on the surface
promises_paid: The primary wound site will be physically visited (PP25)
The wound site has physical presence (PP18)
notes: Use the Veranthos world-building from the concept seed extensively — ring structure, from-orbit description, the beauty that is itself a symptom.
